embedding_plans.name: Plan A: 8-Second Action Clips (Recommended for Semantic Video RAG)
embedding_plans.description: Splits video into 8-second segments, each represented by 8 uniformly sampled frames. Ideal for natural language action retrieval.

embedding_plans.name: Plan B: 2-Second Keyframe Storyboard (Fine-Grained Frame Search)
embedding_plans.description: Extracts 1 keyframe every 2 seconds, embedded as individual images (280 tokens). Enables precise timestamp jumping down to 2 seconds.

embedding_plans.name: Plan C: 15-Second Video + Audio Interleaved (Dense Multimodal Search)
embedding_plans.description: Captures both visual motion and character dialogue simultaneously by combining 15 video frames and 15 seconds of audio per chunk.
